data.title: Brighton & Hove Albion vs Crystal Palace Predictions, Picks & Odds - 18/10/2026
data.content:
Crystal Palace arrive in a far less comfortable position. Fifteenth in the standings with four points from five outings, the Eagles have lost three of their last five league matches and managed only 1.2 goals per match on average. There is some encouragement on the injury front: Jean-Philippe Mateta, Dean Henderson, and Takehiro Tomiyasu are all expected to return, while Ismaïla Sarr is now fit enough to start. Pierre Sage will need every available body for this fierce M23 derby. [...] The M23 derby carries historical tension, and Palace arrive unbeaten in four league meetings with their rivals. Yet Pierre Sage's side have struggled for consistency, scoring only 1.2 goals per match this term. The return of Mateta, Henderson, and Tomiyasu offers a lift, but Palace's away form remains poor and unlikely to trouble Brighton's resolute backline. [...] Over 2.5 goals at 1.55 looks strong given Brighton's attacking output and Palace's defensive vulnerabilities. Both teams to score at 1.62 also merits consideration; Sarr and Khalaili returning to full fitness could give Palace enough thrust to find the net, even if the hosts ultimately prevail. A home victory with goals at both ends feels the likeliest outcome.

data.title: Brighton v Crystal Palace: Prediction, team news, lineups and odds
data.content:
Kaouru Mitoma is continuing his recovery from a hamstring injury sustained in pre-season, while Stefanos Tzimas and Evan Ferguson are long-term absentees.

Femi Azeez and Zadok Yohanna are also unlikely to be involved against Palace, with Fabian Hurzeler revealing that the two summer signings need time to adapt to Brighton’s training methods.

## Crystal Palace team news [...] Dean Henderson has missed Palace’s last five games in all competitions with a foot injury, with Walter Benitez starting between the sticks.

The club captain will face a late fitness test to decide if he can return against Brighton, while Jean-Philippe Mateta, Ben Chilwell and Takehiro Tomiyasu will also need to be assessed before kick-off.

Axel Disasi started against Lyon, but the centre-back won’t be available this weekend as he is serving the last game of a three-match domestic ban. [...] Palace are 5/1 to beat the Seagulls at the Amex Stadium for the third season in a row, while The Draw is 18/5.

Brighton are 11/10 to end the 2026/27 Premier League season in the top five, and Palace are 16/5 to secure a top-10 finish.

## Brighton v Crystal Palace prediction

Palace have the upper hand in this fixture over the last two seasons, winning three and drawing one of the last four Premier League meetings against Brighton.
